title: Gang scheduling: all of a job, or none of it
design_ref: Four layers of scheduling decisions (admission before placement)
purpose: Submit a 4-pod job to a worker that can hold only 3 of the pods. The job must wait whole, with no pods created, instead of starting 3 and holding resources for the 4th.

steps.display: kubectl --context cpu-a create -f job.yaml   # vision/gang-of-4: queue cpu, 4 pod(s) x cpu 1

steps.output:
NAME                                          QUEUE   RESERVED IN   ADMITTED   FINISHED   AGE
workload.kueue.x-k8s.io/job-gang-of-4-79bb3   cpu                   False                 18s

steps.display: kubectl --context cpu-a -n vision get workload -o jsonpath=<the QuotaReserved message>
steps.output: couldn't assign flavors to pod set main: insufficient quota for cpu in flavor cpu-ondemand, previously considered podsets requests (0) + current podset request (4) > maximum capacity (3)

steps.display: kubectl --context cpu-a -n vision delete job gang-of-4
kubectl --context cpu-a create -f job.yaml   # vision/gang-of-3: queue cpu, 3 pod(s) x cpu 1
kubectl --context cpu-a -n vision get workload   # a 3-pod job fits and is admitted whole
steps.output:
NAME                  QUEUE   RESERVED IN   ADMITTED   FINISHED   AGE
job-gang-of-3-c3d21   cpu     vision-cpu    True                  3s

checks.because: The vision queue on this worker can use 3 CPUs at most (1 of its own plus 2 borrowed), and the job needs 4.

checks.description: the job's pod count is zero while it waits
checks.because: Kueue keeps the job suspended. The Job controller creates no pods until the whole gang is admitted.

checks.description: the reason names the missing quota
checks.because: The Workload's condition is the one-line answer to 'why is it pending'.

checks.description: a 3-pod job fits the same queue and is admitted
checks.because: Same queue, same worker: the only difference is the size of the gang.

notes: This test talks to the worker directly, so the result is the worker's own decision.
